text:
JOHN TALBOT:
  Is my name Talbot? Am I your son?
  And I should run away? Father, if you love my mother,
  don't disgrace her good name
  by turning me into a bastard and a coward!
  The world will say he's no son of Talbot,
  the one who ran like a coward while noble Talbot stood his ground.
TALBOT:
  Run, so you can avenge my death if I'm killed.
JOHN TALBOT:
  A man who runs like that never comes back.
TALBOT:
  If we both stay, we'll both be killed. That's certain.
